svg.title: Smart Home for AgentBuff stack
svg.desc: Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, Radix UI. Backend: Node 22, MCP server, WebSocket worker. Data: PostgreSQL 16, Drizzle ORM. AI: MCP for the user's agent. Ops: Docker Compose, Vitest, PGlite, Playwright
svg.text: Versions as pinned in the project.
